note: Staged demo take. The service's mock mode (PSYCHSIM_DEMO_SCRIPT) returns these patient lines when the doctor line matches exactly; brain.guard still drops any fact whose trust level is not met.

turns.doctor: Hello, I'm Dr Rao, one of the doctors here. What brings you in today?

patient.utterance: Hello, doctor. I've been tired all the time, for about two months now. I just don't feel like myself.

turns.doctor: How have you been sleeping, and how is your appetite?

patient.utterance: I fall asleep, but I wake up around four and just lie there. And I skip dinner most days. My clothes feel loose now.

turns.doctor: Whatever you tell me stays between us, unless I'm worried about your safety. How has your mood been lately?

patient.utterance: Low. Empty, most of the day. The mornings are the worst. Sometimes I cry in the washroom at work.

turns.doctor: With so much on your shoulders, it makes sense that you feel this way. Struggling like this doesn't make you weak.

patient.utterance: But I feel so weak. Like a burden. My parents gave up so much for my studies, and I'm failing them.

turns.doctor: Sometimes when people feel this low, they have thoughts of not wanting to live. Have you had any thoughts like that?

patient.utterance: Yes. For about three weeks. Some nights I wish I just wouldn't wake up in the morning. It comes, and then it passes.

turns.doctor: Thank you for telling me, that took courage. Have you made any plans to end your life, or kept any tablets at home?

patient.utterance: No. No plans. I've never thought about how. And there are no tablets at home.
